nodes.label: Domain Skills Registry
nodes.rationale: Domain-specific skills are stored as a JSON registry keyed by domain, injected into the agent system prompt at runtime to prevent known ATS/site interaction mistakes. Each entry encodes verified patterns (e.g., Workday typeahead fields require clicking a dropdown ref, not pressing Enter) learned from real automation runs.

nodes.label: SimplifyJobs GitHub Aggregator Skill
nodes.rationale: Specialized skill for SimplifyJobs README job aggregator repos on GitHub. Critical distinctions: click Apply links by accessibility-tree ref (not screen coordinates), skip rows with locked emoji, call tabs_context immediately after clicking Apply to avoid duplicate ATS tabs, and ignore third-party extension overlays (jobright-helper-plugin, simplify-helper).

nodes.label: JobRight.ai Aggregator Skill
nodes.rationale: Verified pattern for avoiding click loops: click Apply with Autofill once, immediately call tabs_context to detect new tab, switch to ATS tab. Includes guidance to dismiss 'Did you apply?' modal on return. Warns against 80K max_chars reads that inflate cost.

nodes.label: iCIMS ATS Domain Skill
nodes.rationale: Resume upload is inside shadow DOM — must use file_upload tool with numeric ref, not OS dialog. Check PortalProfileFields.Resume_FileName hidden input to confirm upload success rather than re-uploading. Dropdowns use full label text (e.g., 'Asian (Not Hispanic or Latino)').

nodes.label: Workday ATS Skill
nodes.rationale: Typeahead prompt fields are the #1 cause of stuck runs. Correct procedure: short query → read_page (dropdown options appear at top with refs) → left_click the ref. Budget 4 turns per field. Never use javascript_tool to set field values; Workday ignores it. Never press Enter in typeahead fields.

nodes.label: Tesla Careers Skill
nodes.rationale: Tesla uses TDS (Tesla Design System) custom dropdowns with aria-haspopup='listbox'. Phone field has TWO elements (country code button + text input). Legal acknowledgment on Step 3 requires a required checkbox. Login may interrupt and require re-navigating to job URL.

nodes.label: X/Twitter Domain Skill
nodes.rationale: X uses Draft.js editors where form_input silently fails and computer type garbles text. Only reliable method is javascript_tool with execCommand('insertText'). Page loads asynchronously — read_page returns only keyboard shortcut text for 3-5 seconds; use get_page_text instead and never re-navigate to same URL.

nodes.label: MCP Server (Transport & Session Layer)
nodes.rationale: MCP server is strictly a transport/session layer — it must NOT run its own browser-agent LLM loop or define a second copy of browser tools. It exposes 5 tools: browser_start, browser_message, browser_status, browser_stop, browser_screenshot. Concurrency and timeout enforcement happen here.

nodes.label: WebSocket Relay Server
nodes.rationale: Routes tagged task traffic back to originating MCP/CLI client. Queues messages briefly when extension service worker sleeps. Untagged messages still broadcast to all consumers — a known gap.

nodes.label: Chrome Extension Service Worker
nodes.rationale: The extension service worker is the source of truth for browser execution. It owns MCP task state, creates isolated browser windows per task, runs the real browser agent, manages follow-up messages, task cancellation, screenshots, and cleanup.

nodes.label: Native Host IPC (Legacy Transport)
nodes.rationale: Legacy transport that still exists alongside the relay path. Marked as cleanup target — not the target design.

nodes.label: MCP Local Mode (BYOM)
nodes.rationale: User installs via npx hanzi-browse setup, loads extension, AI agent uses browser tools. LLM calls happen in the extension with user's own API key — no data leaves their machine.

nodes.label: devhunt.org Site Knowledge
nodes.rationale: Submission flow documented: submit button is a small circular button at top-right of badge overlay, NOT a traditional submit button below the form. Minimum 3 screenshots required. No autosave — export content externally first. ProductHunt import auto-fills fields and should be done BEFORE manual entry.

nodes.label: httpbin.org Site Knowledge
nodes.rationale: Navigate directly to target URL, not chrome://newtab/, to avoid Chrome extension restriction errors. get_page_text is sufficient for httpbin homepage documentation.

nodes.label: Anti-Bot Site Pattern
nodes.rationale: Some domains (reddit.com, linkedin.com, twitter.com, x.com, tesla.com) are flagged with antiBot:true, indicating enhanced protection that may require extra care with timing, navigation patterns, and avoiding automation detection signals.

nodes.label: Token Efficiency Pattern for ATS Forms
nodes.rationale: Consistent pattern across ATS skills: use get_page_text for job descriptions, read_page only for form interaction with max_chars=20000. Never request 60000-80000 max_chars on listing pages — inflates cost without revealing more content.
nodes.norm_label: token efficiency pattern for ats forms

nodes.label: Shadow DOM File Upload Pattern
nodes.rationale: ATS resume upload fields are often inside shadow DOM. Correct approach: use file_upload tool with numeric ref from read_page (resolves backendNodeIds and pierces shadow DOM). Never click 'My Computer' and type into OS dialog — agent cannot see OS dialogs.

nodes.label: tabs_context After ATS Navigation Pattern
nodes.rationale: After clicking Apply on job aggregators (SimplifyJobs, JobRight), immediately call tabs_context to determine if ATS opened in same tab or new tab. Skipping this check leads to duplicate tab creation or missed tab switches.
